biography.value:
Description

The apex monster of the Ancient Forest, also known as the “Legend of the Skies”. A fierce great wyvern that descends upon invaders, attacking with its venomous claws, glorious roar, and fiery breath.

Defense

AC 25, touch 8, flat-footed 22 (+17 natural, -2 size)

hp 225 [324] (18d12+108)

Fort +17, Ref +11, Will +14

DR 10/magic;

Immune Fire, Paralysis, Poison, Sleep;

Resist Earth 15, Shadow 15

Weakness Lightning and Holy

Offense

Speed 30 ft., Fly 120 ft. (poor)

Melee Tail Slap +24 (2d6+8), Bite +24 (2d6+8 plus grab), 2 Wings +19 (1d8+4) or [Mid-Air] Tail Slap +24 (2d6+8), Bite +24 (2d6+8 plus grab), 2 Claws +19 (1d8+4 plus poison)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft. (15 ft. with Tail)

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (50-ft. Cone, 12d8 fire damage, Reflex DC 25 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Glorious Roar, Fire Roar, Rake (2 claws +19, 1d8+8)

Statistics

Str 26, Dex 11, Con 22, Int 7, Wis 12, Cha 8

Base Atk +18; CMB +28 (+32 grapple and bull rush); CMD 38

Feats Cleave, Greater Bull Rush, Hover, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Grapple, Improved Unarmed Strike, Iron Will, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (Bite)

Skills Fly +15, Perception +23, Sense Motive +23, Stealth +20

Languages Draconic

description.value: Once every 1d2+1 rounds, a greater rathalos roars a fiery cone blast within 30-ft. burst. Any creature within the area of effect takes 10d6 points of fire damage and are inflicted with the Burn status effect for 1d6 rounds. A successful Reflex save (DC 25) reduces the damage by half and negates the status effect. This is a constitution based-save. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).
